title: Managing himself after Lyons left
summary: After Lyons went home, Wooding managed the band himself until returning to America.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: I see. Now, when in 1926, the show was split up and you were now, from then on, you were on your own with the band. Who was booking you and managing you?
Now, cause Arthur Lyons had come home and there wasn't anyone else. There was nobody else that I thought that much of, you see?
So I managed myself clean until I came back to America.
